Now.|The prison commander and the guard, regarding a prison escape|}} A [[human]] served as a '''console guard''' in an [[Unidentified Imperial factory facility|Imperial factory facility]] part of a [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|Prison Complex]] on the [[moon]] [[Narkina 5]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. In [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|110}} they handed out [[blaster]]s towards guards of the complex and ordered them to head to [[Unit Five-Two-D]], a group of [[prisoner]]s who were currently [[Narkina 5 prison escape|escaping]] from the complex. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The console guard first appeared in the [[Andor Season 1|''Andor'' Season 1]] episode "[[One Way Out]]," which released on [[November 9]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}} They were portrayed by [[Chike Chan]] and credited as "Console Guard #2." ==Appearances== *{{Andor|One Way Out}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Guards]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex personnel]]
